explanation: EXCLURAD successfully computed the full O(α) QED radiative corrections to η-meson electroproduction at the specified kinematics with standard CLAS12 settings (beam momentum 6.53 GeV, vcut = 0.166 GeV²). Delta (δ = σ_obs/σ_Born) and sigma_Born are reported exactly as computed by the code at each φ* angle. The kinematics are physically valid (W = 1.5753 GeV is above η production threshold, Q² = 0.3 GeV² is standard, cos θ* = −0.527586 is within [−1, 1]).
